periods.expect: Thin observation; no support promotion; explicit none-offer test and faithful adopted bindings.
One independent compatible trial only; derivatives/overlap/product B cannot promote; next proposal changes executable choice or justifies retaining it.
Contrary sufficient trial lowers same-direction support; preserve historical rankings; new hypothesis or qualified retention.

cases.expect: Other-product campaign verdicts cannot promote product A.
Identical event text from product B cannot promote product A.
Simulation cannot become real-market support on any track.
400-day performance history is not current usable evidence.
Revalidation is enforced by planners and adoption, not just a displayed flag.
Same-ID actual learning_text/support/source/eligibility edit invalidates the displayed revision.
Explicit none-offer is valid even when registered offers exist.
Unknown/null/zero scope, money and provenance remain explicit; no inferred effectiveness.
Tenant/result/currency/attribution cohorts do not mix.
Campaign/coordinate/visual/A-B/settle derivatives, overlap and replay do not add independent trials.
Contrary latest comparable result lowers support; historical results and current-verdict selection remain distinct.
Malformed/unknown scope trailer stays conservative; legacy visual/coordinate scope round-trip remains readable.
Relevant offer expiry and price/material/target changes block stale confirmation; brand facts have no universal age expiry.
Deleted/removed audience and product never silently receive a fallback binding.
Sorting and org-midnight reads do not make revision depend on row order or read timestamp.
Thin sample preserves verdict and rank, with no promotion or automatic scaling.
Duplicate action check writes no duplicate learning; action success is not a causal result.
Adoption receipt and actual audience/offer/carry/test assignments match; exact original copy/images survive.
Ordinary same-scope retry recovers failure, retains last good data and unsaved input.
All three HTML-reference screens match fresh build at 1024 and 1920; five questions and keyboard/source panels pass.
Loading, cold start, failed reads, retry, contrary results and stale proposals are distinct and preserve input.
Diagnose previous timeout; at most one real-provider attempt within 60 seconds; qualified facts/bindable slots/none-offer, no automatic retry.
Genuine local Auth expiry and ordinary login recover supported saved work without forged token.
Isolated Postgres backup restore checks schema, rows, tenant separation and Storage asset references/actual bytes; shared public unchanged.
Source-matched clean integration and one combined packet; all gates explicit; F48-F52 still open; no readiness percentage or extra drill.

failures: Fabrication, wrong scope/confidence/money, inconsistent accepted bindings, silent input loss, unsupported recovery, absent required model/auth/restore proof keep F53 open.
allowed_alternatives: Reasoned allocations/retention; no required profit, prose/image polish or single optimal strategy.
repeat_policy: Rerun only after a relevant change/failure/concern; preserve frozen expectations and raw failed receipts.
fixture_mode: Injected platform reader for market-qualification branches; entire receipt synthetic. Separate actual simulation-provenance cases stay excluded.
